title: Concurrent Height-Balanced Search Tree with Asynchronous Rebalancing in Chronos-Interpreter
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a lightweight concurrent search tree that preserves height-balance and key order while allowing asynchronous rebalancing in a pure Chronos-Interpreter environment. The design leverages fine-grained condition-based locking to coordinate insertions, deletions, and rebalancing without global serialization. Formal invariants guarantee that the tree height remains bounded by $c\log_2 n$ for a constant $c$, and that all key-ordered relationships are maintained throughout concurrent updates. Static analysis of the abstract syntax tree confirms that the implementation satisfies the stated invariants and that all critical paths execute in $O(\log n)$ time. No empirical wall-clock measurements are reported; the analysis is purely theoretical and AST-based. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261104_070221_gist_of_chronos-continuum__con}
